summary: Weatherford International plc filed an 8-K reporting shareholder approval of a scheme of arrangement under Irish law that will result in shareholders owning common stock of Weatherford International Corp, a Delaware corporation, instead of Weatherford-Ireland ordinary shares. The scheme and related resolutions (capital reduction, share issuance authorization) passed at the Special Scheme Meeting and EGM on September 3, 2026. Quorum exceeded 89%. This represents a corporate re-domestication/re-incorporation transaction, with the Delaware entity as the continuing entity. The filing discloses no financial terms, premiums, or advisors; the arrangement appears to be a migration of jurisdiction rather than a leveraged buyout. What to watch: regulatory and court approvals required for scheme effectiveness, and the expected completion timeline.
